items.question: How do credits work?
items.answer: Each generation costs credits based on output type: 1 credit for a UGC photo, 2 for a lifestyle scene, 3 for a UGC video. Every account starts with 5 free credits.

items.question: What happens if a generation fails?
items.answer: Your credit is automatically refunded — you're never charged for a failed generation.

items.question: Can I cancel anytime?
items.answer: Yes. Paid plans can be cancelled anytime from your account settings — there's no lock-in contract.

items.question: Is my uploaded product image safe?
items.answer: Your images are stored securely and only used to generate the content you request.

items.question: Can I use the generated content in my ads?
items.answer: Yes, you own the content you generate. Staying within each ad platform's policies (Meta, TikTok, etc.) is your responsibility, since those policies change over time.

items.question: Is there a free plan?
items.answer: Yes — sign up and get 5 free credits, no credit card required.

sections.heading: Acceptance of Terms
sections.body: By creating an account or using {appName}, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.

sections.heading: Description of Service
sections.body: {appName} turns a single product photo into AI-generated UGC photos, videos, and lifestyle scenes, powered by fal.ai's image and video generation models.

sections.heading: Accounts & Credits
sections.body: Every account starts with free trial credits. Each generation consumes credits based on output type. If a generation fails, your credit is automatically refunded.

sections.heading: Ownership of Generated Content
sections.body: You own the content you generate. You are responsible for ensuring your use of that content complies with the policies of any platform where you publish it, such as Meta or TikTok.

sections.heading: Acceptable Use
sections.body: You may only upload product images you have the rights to use. You may not use the service for unlawful purposes or to infringe on the rights of others.

sections.heading: Subscription & Cancellation
sections.body: Paid plans can be cancelled at any time from your account settings. There are no long-term contracts.

sections.heading: Limitation of Liability
sections.body: The service is provided "as is." Generated content quality can vary, and we are not liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from your use of the service.

sections.heading: Changes to These Terms
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the service after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: If you have questions about these terms, please reach out through your account or the support channels available on this site.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: We collect your account information (name, email), the product images you upload, the content generated on your behalf, and basic usage data.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use this information to provide the generation service, process your requests through our AI infrastructure provider, manage your account and credits, and communicate important service updates.

sections.heading: Data Storage & Security
sections.body: Your account data and images are stored securely, with access limited to what is needed to operate the service.

sections.heading: Third-Party Processors
sections.body: We use fal.ai to process image and video generation. Uploaded images are sent to fal.ai solely to produce the content you request.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your account data at any time.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: See our Cookie Policy for details on the cookies used to operate this service.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this policy from time to time. We encourage you to review it periodically.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: If you have questions about this policy, please reach out through your account or the support channels available on this site.

sections.heading: What Are Cookies
sections.body: Cookies are small files stored in your browser that help websites remember information about your visit.

sections.heading: Essential Cookies
sections.body: We use essential cookies to keep you signed in and maintain your session. The service cannot function without these.

sections.heading: No Third-Party Advertising Cookies
sections.body: We do not currently use third-party advertising or tracking cookies.

sections.heading: Managing Cookies
sections.body: You can control cookies through your browser settings. Disabling essential cookies may prevent you from signing in.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this policy from time to time. We encourage you to review it periodically.
